entry_points.text: Fallback without TPM reports absence on probes, null on default lookup, and no-op on empty auth append.
Basic and extended accounting, integral update, CPU time and integral clear are empty inlines with no action.

exports.text: Provides tnum unknown and low-subregister constness tests; NUMA writers publish per-CPU node and memory affinity while readers query memory node by either direct state or CPU mapping, plus capacity scale query.
Provides compile-time type, function and pointer checks, bitmap declarator sizing by bit count, and RCU, swap and compare callback signatures with and without private context.
Provides counter read, sync init, and fetch begin/retry; one config uses atomics with trivial fetch, the other uses sequence protection with retry on contention.
Checked user copies return uncopied count, allow faults, honor failure injection, and zero trailing bytes on from-path; inatomic forms forbid faults with size validation and nontemporal selection.

Unsafe value and block transfers assume validated region and divert to caller label on error; begin checks accessibility, end is no-op, scoped begin returns masked pointer or validates range with matching close.

hazards.text: Clearing ops during use risks use after clear; invalid buffers stay unusable; upgrade and suspend flags change availability, requiring revalidation.
Hop callers must treat error pointers as absence and test before dereference as iteration does.
From helper zeroes remainder and orders checks; unsafe get assumes validated region and must divert to label without assuming progress.

invariants.text: Unknown holds when all mask bits are set; subregister constness holds when derived low view carries zero mask.
Distance local if nodes match else remote; count is mask weight; sibling, core, cluster, die and SMT are singletons with node mask via CPU to node; primary lowest; nth ignores node; hop unsupported.

Upgrade reflects flag; handle type is top byte; rc clears bit seven; ret maps shortage to nomem, hash fail to inval, rest to perm; chip derives from device; auth is session or null; empty auth appends nine-byte trailer or no-op.
Device, inode, mode, process, user, sizes, fixed-width integer and sector aliases map to internals; short mode is unsigned short.
Read zero write one; page offset unsigned long; DMA and physical have 64/32 variants; allocation and file-mode flags are distinct bitwise types; aligned 64 variants alias arch bases.
Untag identity with remote asserting mmap lock; masked uses common begin or identity fallback; handler-disabled combines atomic with nesting; mc copy succeeds; release store orders priors.
Topology, bit, per-CPU, cpumask and sequence helpers depend on external primitives for storage, masks, bit ops and fetch protection, owned outside this dossier.

locks.text: Ops callbacks require holding ops_sem with sysfs acquiring implicitly and pointer cleared on unregister; commands serialize on tpm_mutex with single opener.
On 32-bit init prepares sequence and readers bracket with begin/retry repeating on contention; on 64-bit both are trivial via wrappers.
Remote untag asserts mmap lock held; scoped guard disables faults on acquisition and re-enables on release.

state_machines.text: Distance iteration picks nearest unvisited, clears it, stops after max; hop iteration starts zero, yields online for no-node else queries helper until absence or failure.
Without HMAC start ok, end no-op, fill ok, check returns input status, so no transition observed.
Faults enabled at zero nesting, disabled when positive, with paired inc/dec transitions.

structs.text: Tnum value plus mask; atomics wrap counters with refcount form; lists next/prev and hashed first/next-prev; callbacks next plus function; stats sync empty on 64-bit else sequence with per-CPU or plain counters.

Ops has flags plus completion then xfer, status, timeout, idle, locality, clock; space, log, seq and hash hold tables, windows, wrappers and ids; chip chains device, sem, logs, identity, hwrng, timeouts, bios, banks, workspace, commands, locality and HMAC with 12 flag bits; buf flags, handles, len, cap, payload with TPM2B and invalid.

Local 10 remote 20 bits 8 reclaim 30 penalty 1; TPM digest 20 buf 4096; TPM2 digest max is SHA512 extent name plus two banks 8 space 16384 header 10 hashes 5 RNG 128; timeouts A 750 B 4000 C 200 D 30 short 20 med 750 long 2000 longlong 300000 default 120000.
